rule: Opt-in clock: the battle timer is off by default and only starts when a player requests it. When on, each side has a bank (150 s plus 60 s grace), gains a fixed add per own turn (25 s non-singles, 10 s singles), and an inactive side loses when the bank runs out. Re-enabling is blocked for 20 s after someone turns it off. Accelerated per-turn add only after turns 100 and 200, and only when no timer rule is set. First-run: guest name on connect, random-team formats for the first battle (no team build), and onboarding only as chat commands (/intro, /smogintro) that the user asks for.
keep: Clock is opt-in; the first battle has no clock unless someone asks for one.
Bank plus per-turn add rather than a fixed per-turn clock.
Re-enable cooldown so nobody toggles the clock every turn.
Random first team so the first battle needs no build step.
Onboarding as text the player asks for, not a forced tutorial.
change: Frankendom fast duels are real time: the bank model fits only menu or turn steps (town hall, trade, ledger), not the fight loop.
No first-30-minute progression exists in the donor; Frankendom needs its own first-reward ladder (see the keldaanCommunity-pokemonAutoChess note).
